text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: paging @oncall-sre — elevated streaming tail latency detected across prod eu-west-1 for /v1/stream (SSE + WS). p95 and p99 spikes, increased client disconnects. Auto-alerting thresholds hit. Thread started 5176543210

IncidentBot: Detected anomalies: p95 chunk latency 3.2s (baseline 150ms), p99 chunk latency 12s, error rate (stream disconnect) 0.42% -> paging. Links: https://monitoring/redwood/prod/streams?from=-15m

Jordan (oncall-sre): Acknowledged. I'm on it. Pulling traces now. Anyone seeing related deploys?

Lia (eng-runtime): no recent deploys in eu-west-1 in the last hour. I'm checking runtime metrics and proxy logs. Initial thought: proxy backpressure + client slow consumers causing long write queues.

Marco (platform-eng): I'm verifying capacity/queueing on the regional gateway and egress VMs. Auto-scaler shows no recent scale-ups; pods CPU comfy but socket write queues high on the gateway. Could be slow socket drains to clients.

Jordan (oncall-sre): Adding context: customers on streaming endpoints report stalls where the connection remains open but chunks stop for ~20-60s then resume. This lines up with p99 spikes.

Kai (customer-success): We're getting inbound chatter from two accounts (finance-app, chat-ops) noticing UI freezes and reconnects. They're seeing resumed text in chunks but with visible gaps. Customer-impact likely moderate. I'll prepare a short blurb.

Lia (eng-runtime): Collecting sample logs. Past 10m from stream-proxy (eu-west-1):

```
[2026-03-15T12:03:21Z] INFO conn=abcd write_queue=256 pending_chunks=4 last_chunk_ms=3100
[2026-03-15T12:03:23Z] WARN conn=efgh write_err=EAGAIN write_queue=1024 backlog=512
[2026-03-15T12:03:25Z] DEBUG client=10.2.3.45 rx_window=64 tx_window=2
```

Lia (eng-runtime): The proxy shows EAGAIN on socket writes and large internal queues. Looks like a combination of slow consumer connections + proxy using default timeouts that allow huge buffer buildup.

Marco (platform-eng): I can nudge the gateway to enable `proxy_write_timeout=10s` and `sendfile off` temporarily, and reduce `max_write_queue` to avoid tail amplification. That will cause faster disconnects for the worst clients but should free resources. Thoughts?

Jordan (oncall-sre): Good mitigation. We want to avoid broad customer disconnects but need to restore p99. Proposed short-term mitigations (15m window):
- reduce proxy write timeout to 8-12s
- enable aggressive write backpressure drop for connections with >200KB queued
- enable fallback routing for VIP customers to non-streaming endpoints (polling) if we detect repeated disconnects

Lia (eng-runtime): I'm prepared to flip `streaming.buffer_limit=200KB` and `socket_keepalive=30s` on the runtime side. Also investigating whether prefix/KV caching is being poisoned by long tails.

Marco (platform-eng): Rolling proxy config change to a small percentage of gateways (canary) first: will apply to 10% of nodes in eu-west-1 and watch. Command: `infractl proxy-config apply --region eu-west-1 --policy write-timeout-10s --subset 10%`

Jordan (oncall-sre): Please annotate the change in this thread. Lia, can you monitor p95/p99 and open traces for any connection ids that disconnect?

Lia (eng-runtime): Will do. Starting trace collection and sampling more verbose socket events `runtime.debug.socket=true` for the canary.

IncidentBot: OpsBot flagged potential correlated increase in TLS renegotiations on gateways at 12:02:30Z.

Kai (customer-success): Quick customer note draft: "We're investigating elevated streaming latency for EU customers. We're applying targeted mitigations to reduce tail latency and will update within 30 minutes. If you see repeated reconnects, please send connection id."

Jordan (oncall-sre): After canary deploy (10%): p95 down from 3.2s -> 260ms on canary nodes; p99 on canary down from 12s -> 1.1s. Non-canary nodes unchanged. Early win.

Marco (platform-eng): Canary looks good. Rolling to 50% now, monitoring. Rolling command: `infractl proxy-config apply --region eu-west-1 --subset 50%`

Lia (eng-runtime): Observed side effect: some long-lived clients got disconnected by new aggressive write-timeout; reconnects succeeded and backfills chunks fine. We saw a transient spike in reconnect counts + 200 OK replays.

Jordan (oncall-sre): Good. Customer impact tradeoff acceptable — fewer prolonged stalls. Marco, roll to 100% when ready.

Marco (platform-eng): Rolling to 100% now. ETA ~2m for full propagation.

Jordan (oncall-sre): Monitoring after full roll. Current numbers (eu-west-1 aggregated): p95=320ms, p99=980ms, stream disconnect rate 0.09% (down from 0.42%).

Lia (eng-runtime): I will follow up with a runtime patch to improve backpressure handling so we don't need aggressive timeouts: plan to limit internal queue size per-connection and prefer dropping oldest chunk when queue is saturated. I'll open a PR referencing this incident.

Kai (customer-success): Sending update to impacted customers now. Notifying finance-app and chat-ops: short note + link to status page.

Jordan (oncall-sre): Closing pages. We'll keep this thread for postmortem notes. Key action items:
- runtime: implement queue limit + smarter drop policy (Lia)
- infra: add proxy-level telemetry for socket write queue depth (Marco)
- support: customer follow-ups and RCA timeline (Kai)
- oncall: collect traces for at least 24h for affected connections (Jordan)

Jordan (oncall-sre): Incident status -> mitigated. Will flip to monitor and file incident report. :white_check_mark:

OpsBot: Incident record created: INC-2026-0315-5176543210. Owner: Jordan. Severity: Sev2. Link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-2026-0315-5176543210

Jordan (oncall-sre): Postmortem follow-up: please add any observations here.

Lia (eng-runtime): Noted — I'll attach logs and the PR once created. Also recording that client-side slow consumers + proxy unlimited buffers combined to create tail amplification.

Marco (platform-eng): I'll add a dashboard tile for `gateway.write_queue_bytes` and an alert at 75th percentile > 128KB.

Kai (customer-success): All customer notifications sent, one customer requested ETA for RCA — I'll sync with Lia and Jordan on ETA for postmortem.

Jordan (oncall-sre): Thanks team. End of thread for now"
